chunks: 1713 - Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Thus Allah will show them their deeds as regrets upon them."

He عليه السلام said: "It is the man who leaves his wealth and does not spend it in the obedience of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, out of miserliness, then he dies and leaves it to one who acts with it in the obedience of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, or in disobedience to Allah. If he acts with it in the obedience of Allah, he sees it in the scale of another, so he sees it as a regret, though the wealth had been his. And if he acted with it in disobedience to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, he strengthened him with that wealth until he acted with it in disobedience to Allah, Mighty and Majestic."

key_terms.بُخْلًا: miserliness that prevents charitable or obedient use of wealth
key_terms.بِمَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ: in disobedience to Allah by sinful use of wealth
key_terms.حَسَرَاتٍ: causes of regret and remorse on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ: obedience to Allah through rightful and virtuous spending
key_terms.مَالَهُ: his wealth or property that he withheld
key_terms.مِيزَانِ: the scale of deeds in which acts are weighed

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explain the verse 'Thus Allah will show them their deeds as regrets upon them'?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains this verse as referring to a person who withholds wealth from rightful spending out of miserliness. After his death, that wealth becomes either a source of reward for someone else or a means of sin, and in both cases it becomes a cause of regret for the one who hoarded it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1713 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) regarding the words of Allah (swt), the Exalted,
"Thus Allah (swt) will show them their deeds as regrets upon them" (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:167),

said:
"This refers to a man who hoards his wealth and refrains from spending it in the obedience of Allah (swt), the Exalted, out of miserliness. Then he dies and leaves it behind for someone who either uses it in the obedience of Allah (swt) or in His disobedience. If it is used in obedience to Allah (swt), he will see it recorded in someone else's scale of deeds and will feel regret, for the wealth was originally his. And if it is used in disobedience to Allah (swt), he will have enabled the person who committed sins with that wealth, furthering their disobedience to Allah (swt), the Exalted."
